rubric_items.reason: All 14 acceptance criteria (S-1/AC1-5, S-2/AC1-4, S-3/AC1-5) map to at least one test whose title asserts the criterion's outcome; no test claims a criterion that does not exist.

Counting rules sit at API integration level, rendering at jsdom unit level, and the single manual test (TP-17, layout) is justified by the absence of browser tests. TP-12 overlaps an existing test but is not at too high a level.

Each of EP-1, EP-2 and EP-3 has a success and a negative test, plus a key-shape boundary and a PATCH-body-ignored test. Missing: a boundary above the 100-appointment list cap that motivated the server-side count.

Uses Vitest with Supertest on throwaway PostgreSQL and a fixed clock, and Testing Library under jsdom; target files follow api/test and web/src/__tests__; titles start with the HMS-5 REQ id like neighbouring tests.

Titles are concrete, with data and expected values a tester can run. The TP-4 wording 'outside its Last 30 days period' is awkward, and the regression tests' covers links are loose, though the plan says so.

findings.text: No boundary test has a patient with more than 100 Completed/No-show appointments. The design computes the counts on the server because the loaded list stops at 100, so a count above the cap is the boundary that proves the count is not derived from the list.

cites.quote: because the appointments the page already loads stop at a default `limit = 100` (C8)
TP-21 (integration, boundary, EP-1): `visitSummary` holds only the two integer keys.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an integration test: a patient with 101 Completed appointments returns visitSummary.completed = 101 while the appointments list stays capped.

findings.text: TP-20 (POST with invalid fields is 400) is linked to S-2/AC3, which is about a patient with no appointments showing 0 for each. The test does not assert that criterion; the plan admits these tests guard endpoints, not story outcomes.

cites.quote: These guard the design's endpoints EP-1, EP-2 and EP-3 rather than a story outcome.
TP-20 (integration, negative, EP-2): POST with invalid fields is still 400 with field errors and no `visitSummary`.

findings.suggested_fix: Keep the covers link but say in the Known section that TP-18 to TP-23 do not count towards criterion coverage, which TP-1 to TP-17 already give in full.

findings.text: TP-12 re-tests the existing appointment order of the patient detail, which api/test/patients.test.ts already asserts (PAT-3). The plan does not say whether TP-12 adds new cases (past-only) or relies on that existing test.

cites.quote: PAT-3: shows details, history and appointments, upcoming first
TP-12 (integration, S-3/AC1, S-3/AC2): the API still orders appointments upcoming first

findings.suggested_fix: State that TP-12 adds the past-only case and the order with visitSummary present, and that PAT-3 stays as the upcoming-first regression.
